name: Kit

intro.text: {player}. The Moot. Look at us. Two kids from Macclesfield with a stone each in our pockets. Well, you've got ten.
One last battle before you go in. Not for the viewers. Just for us. Ready?

win: Best friend I've ever had, and the most annoying. Go on. Go and win the whole thing.
after: I'll be right here. Cheering. Loudly. Embarrassingly.
